description: Rebuilds a part or an assembly (only what changed; everything with force) and reports its rebuild errors and warnings by feature; an assembly's include its mates' errors, each named by the mate. After changing a component's part, rebuild the assembly that uses it.

document.description: The document: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.

force.description: Rebuild every feature, not only what changed. Default false.
